text:
marta_cs: Heads-up — Acera (early-access) replied to onboarding invite. They want to kick off next Tue but listed three blockers: SSO not routing, quota limits causing 429s in integration tests, and concerns about API key rotation cadence. Can we triage owners?
josh_pm: assigning owners now. leo for SSO + keys, ana for quota/autoscale checks, cora for enablement docs & runbook.
leo_se: I can take SSO + key rotation. quick Q: are they on Okta or Azure AD?
sam_acera: Hi all — we're on Okta, and our security team requires keys to rotate every 7 days. Also we hit 429s during a 5k reqs/min sim test yesterday.
nana_sre: (note: should be ana_sre) ana_sre: @sam_acera thanks — can you paste a small curl repro or the load test script? 429s could be batching config or rate limit from dedicated env.
sam_acera: sharing snippet: ```bash
wrk -t12 -c400 -d60s https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
``` they ran against sandbox key. We can dm logs if needed.
leo_se: Okta — got it. Our current SSO flow supports SAML 2.0. I'll send an IdP metadata endpoint example and a short checklist for ACS/EntityID config.
leo_se: Pasting example config we usually send: `acs: https://console.redwood.ai/sso/callback` `entityId: redwood-acera`
cora_enable: I'll prepare a one-pager for their security team: rotation options (7d vs 30d), short-term workarounds (per-environment keys + CI secret manager integration), and an enablement call script.
josh_pm: Can we aim to resolve SSO & key rotation before Tue? Quota is lower risk if we can bump autoscale/limits for the first 48h of the pilot.
nana_sre: ana_sre: I can temporarily raise the request cap for their sandbox pool + enable burst scaling. Need confirmation of expected peak qps — @sam_acera what's your peak?
sam_acera: peak ~5k rps during sim, typical expected production ~400 rps. The 5k was intentionally aggressive.
nana_sre: noted. We'll set burst capacity for next Tue window to cover 5k. Also will add KV cache for prefix reuse to reduce load.
marta_cs: risk note: customer asked about renewal if they can't run scale tests — flagging as high-touch. Let's log this in Gainsight and set a follow-up in 2 weeks.
josh_pm: Agree. I'll create a 'pilot health' card and assign follow-up. Also scheduling: can we do a 30m technical handoff Fri 10am PT?
sam_acera: Fri 10am PT works. Please include security lead (ali@acera.com).
leo_se: I'll draft the SAML metadata email + ephemeral key rotation doc before EOD Thurs.
cora_enable: I'll prepare the enablement runbook and invite them to our onboarding workshop recording.
product-bot: Reminder: add SSO compatibility test to onboarding checklist — ticket #PLAT-5021 created.
marta_cs: thanks everyone. After the Fri call, let's post a short summary in this thread and mark action items done. :white_check_mark:
